title: how split an array to smaller array and keep other columns unchaned?
question:
How I can split an array to smaller part and keep other columns unchanged?

suppose I have column loc I wanna split it with respect of " ". whatever is between " " is a new array.

example:

loc                                                    name
["345 canada", "60 bagh ave", "450 seelon st"]        meta
["457 ghaem shahr, vancouver,ca"]                      meta2
["this is bad", "560 nepal rd, west van, ca"]          meta3

output:

loc                                                     name
["345 canada"]                                          meta
["60 bagh ave"]                                          meta
["450 seelon st"]                                        meta
["457 ghaem shahr, vancouver,ca"]                        meta2
["this is bad"]                                          meta3
["560 nepal rd, west van, ca"]                           meta3
answer:
Lets use higher order functions to create list of list within loc and then explode;

df.withColumn('x', expr('explode(transform(loc,(x,i) -> array(x)))')).show(truncate=False)
